name: Leather
overview: Scripture reveals leather as a significant material in biblical times, used both practically and symbolically. God clothed Adam and Eve with coats made from skins, demonstrating His provision and care after the fall (Genesis 3:21). Leather also appears in the context of ritual purity and sacrifice, as seen in the burning of a bullock's hide outside the camp (Leviticus 8:17). Additionally, leather girdles or belts were common attire, notably worn by John the Baptist as a mark of his prophetic lifestyle (Matthew 3:4; Mark 1:6). The mention of Simon the tanner in Acts (9:43; 10:5) highlights the importance of leatherworking professions in the early church.
